claims.statement: CONFIRMED (exact match, source: Yamatsu arXiv:1511.08771v2, Table 1384, p.10305/F.5.1.1): E6 ⊃ so(10)⊕u(1) gives 78 = (16)(3) ⊕ (45)(0) ⊕ (1)(0) ⊕ (16)(−3). claims.statement: CONFIRMED (exact match, both sources): E6 ⊃ so(10)⊕u(1) fundamental 27 = (10)(2) ⊕ (16)(−1) ⊕ (1)(−4), with conjugate 27bar = (10)(−2) ⊕ (16)(1) ⊕ (1)(4).
